indian-valley-faith-fellowship-harleysvi.assessment: Indian Valley Faith Fellowship in Harleysville, Pennsylvania has been led by Senior Pastor Dean Landry since July 2014, after his 16+ years of pastoral ministry at a church in Northern Michigan. Pastor Landry holds a B.A. from Baptist Bible College of PA and two graduate degrees — from Bethel College and Grand Rapids Theological Seminary. Family Pastor Nate Paine fills out the multi-pastor team. The Alliance of Mennonite Evangelical Congregations (AMEC) represents the conservative Anabaptist-evangelical body that broke from Mennonite Church USA in 2002 over doctrinal and sexuality concerns — its two-fold confessional commitment is to evangelical orthodoxy and historic biblical Anabaptism. For a Montgomery County or Harleysville-area man wanting a complementarian, biblically-grounded, Anabaptist-pietist church with a graduate-degreed expository pastor, Indian Valley Faith Fellowship is a strong candidate.
